_comment: Template schedule. Replace currency and market for your country, then replace the three example items with items you derived from a real source. Delete an example rather than leaving a number you cannot defend.

price_basis.source: unknown - name the source of your cost bands
price_basis.note: Bands are order-of-magnitude, not quotes. Re-baseline when the basis is older than a quarter.

items.name: Engine oil + oil filter
items.spec: Grade and approval from the manual for this engine code. Capacity with filter: confirm on the dipstick.
items.if_unknown: Change now. Oil is the cheapest insurance on an old engine.
items.notes: EXAMPLE ITEM. Replace the interval and the band with values from the manufacturer plan for this engine and market.

items.name: Brake fluid
items.spec: DOT4 unless the manual says otherwise. Bleed all four corners.
items.if_unknown: Replace now. Fluid absorbs water and boils under load.
items.notes: EXAMPLE ITEM. Time matters more than distance. A 5-year-old fluid can be at boiling point after two hard stops.

items.name: Periodic technical inspection
items.spec: Depends on the market: interval, fee, documents and the items checked. Put the local rule here.
items.if_unknown: Look up the rule for this region and book the appointment.
items.notes: EXAMPLE ITEM. Time-only: interval_km is 0. Copy the exact local rule into spec, including which month applies.
